editorial.blurb: Real Thai Restaurant delivers genuinely authentic Thai cuisine with vibrant, well-balanced flavors and exceptional service at approachable prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about the secret Thai menu for access to standout dishes like papaya salad with crab and fermented fish, and don't miss the crispy mussel pancake—order it every visit according to regulars.
